scope: Bounded static operational review of guarded original-main fast-forward and owned-topic cleanup helpers. No top-level helper execution, Git/GitHub mutation or new scientific acceptance.
authorship: Reviewer authored round91 gorceixite/florencite-Ce and independently reviewed cable/natrojarosite; those scientific roles are unrelated to these root-authored publication helpers.

checks.name: Complete helper source inspection and AST syntax parsing
checks.details: Both complete sources read; AST parsed without evaluating their top-level mutation code.

checks.name: Cleanup derivation
checks.details: Exact text comparison establishes cleanup is the round90 predecessor with literal round90-to-round91 substitution only.

checks.name: Scoped cleanup and exact merge
checks.details: Requires live merged PR exact topic head, clean owned branch/current head, fetched remote main exact merge/tree and sole reviewed-base parent. Remote deletion has an exact old-head force-with-lease. Only after deletion confirmation does it detach and delete the exact owned local branch. It keeps the clean worktree detached at the topic head, not the merge commit; this is explicit in its checks/receipt.

checks.name: Original-main convergence gate
checks.details: Requires terminal postmerge receipt exact merge/topic/tree/base, log hash and allowed exits plus strict record/history/native review commands. Its producer was read to confirm fresh-clone tree/sole-parent, topic-absence and coverage gates precede success. Main must still be clean on main at reviewed base and remote main must equal the supplied merge; exact merge tree/sole parent are independently checked before ff-only/no-autostash.

checks.name: Hidden/ignored original preservation
checks.details: All 7220 baseline nontracked entries are checked before and after by file size/content hash/mode or symlink target/mode. git ls-files --others -z deliberately omits exclude-standard, so current ignored/hidden entries participate in incoming tracked-file ancestor/descendant collision checks. Retained tag object and peeled commit plus durable backup manifest are checked twice.

limitations: Static acceptance does not establish any future PR, merge, deletion, postmerge check or main fast-forward has occurred. Runtime receipts and live checks remain necessary.

The declared preservation scope is baseline nontracked main files and symlink identities/modes. External symlink targets are not followed, empty directories are not inventoried, and this helper does not assert restoration/preservation of the separately disclosed earlier unrelated skill deviation.
The sync receipt reports original baseline entries preserved; it does not assert equality of the entire later ignored-file inventory. New ignored entries are collision-checked, not deleted.
External receipt producer integrity and coordinator sequencing are trusted as in the current publication pipeline; no new broad runtime test suite was executed by this reviewer.
